referrals.page_subtitle: Invite friends & entrepreneurs to earn 2-tier lifetime commissions and bonus loyalty coins
referrals.multi_tier_desc: Share your personal invite link or QR code with friends. Every time they shop or sell, commission is deposited directly into your Escrow Vault and Loyalty Coins balance.
referrals.step1_desc: Send your link via WhatsApp, Facebook, or QR flyer.
referrals.step2_desc: They register and get special welcome discounts.
referrals.step3_desc: Receive lifetime commissions (5% / 2%) + 100 Coins per friend.
referrals.faq_q1: How does the 2-tier referral commission work?
referrals.faq_a1: When a friend registers using your link (Tier 1), you earn 5% on their qualifying purchases or sales. When your friends invite their own network (Tier 2), you earn an additional 2% on those transactions as well!
referrals.faq_q2: When do I get my referral payouts?
referrals.faq_a2: Commissions enter a 7-day escrow holding period (protecting against returns). Once cleared, funds move directly into your available Vault balance for instant withdrawal via bKash, Nagad, or Bank.
referrals.faq_q3: Can customers as well as sellers refer friends?
referrals.faq_a3: Yes! Anyone with an Explooro account can invite friends, earn cash commissions, and collect bonus Loyalty Coins for checkout discounts.
referrals.qa_desc: Quickly test live referral events and watch state update in real-time:
referrals.anti_fraud_notice: Anti-Fraud & Escrow Security Policy: Self-referrals across same devices/credentials, circular loops, and artificial signups are automatically blocked. Commissions clear from escrow after the 7-day customer return window.
